resolved within the published service standard, weakening reliance for obligation OBL-126.

controls.

re-test. Accountable executive: Head of Regulatory Compliance.

This model supports decisions concerning Customer Due Diligence and operates within the
transaction monitoring system.

Known limitation: performance degrades where the input population differs materially from
the development sample. Compensating control: CTL-400.

Independent validation confirmed the model is fit for purpose. Governance follows 12 CFR 30
Appendix D — standards for risk governance. Ongoing monitoring reports the exception rate
against the approved standard.

Q-Bank is required to maintain arrangements covering Customer Due Diligence.

Source: 12 CFR 21.21 — programme for monitoring compliance with the Bank Secrecy Act.

Interpretation: the obligation requires that collateral is valued using an independent
source at the required frequency. It is discharged operationally through control CTL-400.

Breach of this obligation is reportable to the Head of Regulatory Compliance by the end of
the following month.
